title: 12 Fall Outfit Ideas for Women, Built From Earth Tones
description: Twelve fall outfit ideas in rust, camel, olive and cream, plus five basics from Amazon listings to build them, each under $40, with one honest limit per pick.
dek: Rust, camel, olive and cream. Twelve looks to browse, five basics to build them.
hook: Fall outfits come down to a few repeat pieces: a knit, a straight jean, a boot and one layer on top. Browse the twelve looks first, then pick the basics that fit the ones you like.
We did not test these. We read each listing and use only what it says, so check the size chart and details on the page before you buy.
skipped: Anything where the listing does not say what the item is made of or how it is sized.
Brand-name designer pieces, since this guide is about fall basics at everyday prices.
Anything sold only in one color or size range with no size chart on the listing.
how_picked: Each pick is under the price bracket shown.
The listing says what the item is and how it is cut or sized.
The listing gives a check or limit worth knowing before you buy.
Specs come from the listing text. Review counts and star ratings are not used here.
final: If you only buy one, make it the straight jean. It works with every look in the gallery. Add the cable knit next, then boots and a scarf once the weather turns.
hero_alt: Four fall outfit concept images in rust, olive, cream and camel tones side by side
gallery_intro: Each look uses a short palette and four to five pieces. The swatches show the colors, and the picks below cover the basics that appear most often.
